content.rendered:
Introducing our newest screen to further automate MRF designs

We always strive to provide the best solutions for our customers. That’s why we are partnering with Günther to offer spiral shaft screening technology for front-end MRF operations in North America. Günther is the original designer of the spiral shaft. Günther’s manufacturing is the best in the world.

SPLITTER Screen

Advantages

  • Interlocking screws separate materials in three directions (forward, lateral, and throughs)
  • Adjustable gaps to customize sizing needs
  • Heavy duty steel spirals for minimal wear
  • Non-wrapping, self-cleaning and low maintenance
  • Gentle operation (no glass breaking)

Applications

  • Single stream
  • Commercial waste
  • MSW
  • C&D
  • Source Separated Organics Cleanup
  • Organics Processing
  • Soils Cleanup

Screen Designs

Original

Wave

Twin Wave
